# Recorded Open WebUI 0.13.3 responses

Responses recorded from a real Open WebUI 0.13.3 instance (installed from PyPI, offline mode, 2026-11-12).
Tokens, user ids, e-mail addresses and profile image URLs are replaced with `REDACTED`.
The `dummy-not-secret` valve value was planted on purpose. `source_*.py` are the files that were uploaded.
